system.description:
He wants a world of silence. No life — only undead servitude.

  • Dark Gift (1st): When you kill a creature with a damaging cantrip or spell, it rises as a zombie under your control at the start of your next turn. One at a time; it lasts 1 hour per Warlock level and counts as your summon.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Passive: you always know the location of corpses, undead, and dying creatures within 60ft, even through walls. You can sense the approximate time of death of any corpse you touch.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, touch a corpse dead no longer than 1 day per Warlock level — it rises as a wight under your control for 1 hour per Warlock level.
